sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:91

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:91:1
items.html: The aperture of the nose, and it is the nose of AA, and in it is hidden the Malchut of Atik Yomin: It was already explained above that she is the discernment of the bottom two thirds of the NH of Atik, and since there are no three lines there in the bottom two thirds, she is therefore reckoned by the name of Malchut, and not by the name of NHY. And therefore they are two apertures, corresponding to NH: from the one, life is drawn, which is the right, called Netzah; and from the one, the life of lives is drawn, which is the secret of the left, called Hod. And what is said, in the secret of the verse, “Smoke rose in His nostrils” — this refers to the nose of ZA, as is written in the Zohar.
